title: Wideband Free Space
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Environment and Target/Wideband_Free_Space.md
text: Free space environment, 5 inputs, 1 output; {Propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Signal carrier frequency (Hz)} sets the signal carrier frequency 3e8, {Perform two-way propagation}, {Inherit sample rate}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sampling rate, {Maximum one-way propagation distance (m)} sets the maximum one-way propagation and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
